enforcement: the origin_method vocabulary carries the not-distinguished value (state-catalog.csv capture.origin_method) and the PWA capture path writes it for every capture; STRUCTURAL, NOT A ROUTE CHECK: apps/app/src/lib/capture/upload.ts's buildCreateIntentBody is the one place this client's request body is assembled and its CaptureInput type carries no field through which any other originMethod could be routed, so origin_not_distinguished is the only value this build can send. The route deliberately cannot enforce this - INV-087 forbids a client-discriminating field, so upload-intents.create accepts native_camera from any caller by design and the guarantee has to be client-side; no screen package render demo or sales sentence claims camera-versus-gallery discrimination
test_evidence: PWA-capture-writes-not-distinguished tests asserting the literal JSON body handed to fetch (apps/app/src/lib/capture/upload.test.ts) and the persisted row after a real capture (apps/app/tests/field-capture.int.test.ts); route-does-not-discriminate-by-client contrast test asserting upload-intents.create still returns 201 for native_camera (apps/app/tests/field-capture.int.test.ts), which is what makes the client-side enforcement above the ONLY enforcement; a browser-driven capture through the real screen (apps/app/qa/field.mjs)

statement: Publication order and version_no order agree within one contract: contract_versions.publish REFUSES a draft while a version of the same contract is already published carrying a higher version_no; so the highest published version_no is always the most recently agreed baseline and «the contract's current version» is answerable by that read alone
enforcement: refusal inside contract_versions.publish taken under the same per-contract advisory lock contract_versions.create uses for numbering; renumbering the draft instead is not available because app.guard_contract_version() admits only status published_at published_by and source_manifest_hash on the draft -> published transition. NOT COVERED AND NAMED SO: import_batches.publish takes no such lock so an import committing inside the window is not excluded
test_evidence: overtaken-draft-refused tests over a draft opened before an import publish; a test that the assignment route's current-published-version read returns the baseline published most recently
applies_to: v0.1-M1 — added 2026-08-07 from M1 review finding 4: contract_versions.create numbers a draft at DRAFT time while import_batches.publish numbers at PUBLISH time so a manual draft could be overtaken and the baseline published second became invisible to assignments.create

statement: Performed quantity is recorded UNVALUED until admission: progress.record writes no valuation_allocations row and the carve happens inside the stage-closure transaction which is the v0.1 admission event; a refused closure carves nothing because a refused closure writes nothing at all; and a progress_allocation_heads row carrying reserved_quantity 0 with no allocation beside it is a valid and possibly long-lived state that no projection or command may read as an error
enforcement: valuation_allocations.admitted_by_closure_id names the admission that carved the row and is pinned by two composite foreign keys meeting on admitted_work_assignment_id so the row belongs to a progress fact of the very assignment whose stage was closed (migration 0046); the va_insert policy admits that arm only to a holder of stage_closures.close and only inside a project the actor can read. NOT COVERED AND NAMED SO: nothing forbids a recording-time carve — the CHECK that would is written out in migration 0046's header and is deliberately withheld because it would equally forbid progress.adjust from correcting admitted money and ADR-008 declines to decide what such a correction does
test_evidence: a progress.record that writes no valuation row; a refused closure that carves nothing; an admitted allocation naming the closure that carved it; an allocation naming a closure of a different assignment refused by the composite key rather than by a route

statement: A non-null work_items.work_type_key names at least one requirement_rule_version that is published in the same workspace or is already bound to that line's own contract version; a key resolving to nothing is REFUSED AT THE KEYSTROKE rather than absorbed — a work type no rule version carries yields an empty obligation set a vacuous stage closure and an act composed over nothing while every per-row constraint in this database still passes which is a silent failure wearing a green suite. NULL IS NOT AN ERROR AND IS NOT THIS INVARIANT'S SUBJECT: a null key matches nothing is disclosed as work_type_unresolved (INV-072) and is what every line the frozen importer wrote carries
enforcement: app.work_type_key_is_bindable — SECURITY DEFINER over workspace_id / contract_version_id / work_type_key with two arms: a rule version PUBLISHED in the workspace or one ALREADY BOUND to that line's own contract version so retiring the last carrier of a key cannot trap a person mid-draft. Called by work_items_work_type_guard (BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE on public.work_items) and independently by the command which returns VALIDATION_FAILED on the workTypeKey field so the person typing is told at the keystroke and not at publication (migration 0050 §5 and §6.4). NOT COVERED AND NAMED SO: set membership refuses a key that resolves to NOTHING and cannot refuse a key that is merely the WRONG ONE of two real ones — that needs the owning ENTITY which glossary.md line 109 defers to an ADR and which 0050 deliberately did not build; and this is a per-row refusal so it says nothing about whether the baseline AS A WHOLE is reachable which is INV-083's 2026-08-08 extension
test_evidence: an unbindable key refused at work_items.create and at work_items.update; the same key refused from the TABLE OWNER with RLS bypassed so the trigger and not the route is what refuses; both arms of the resolver probed from a neighbouring workspace; arm 2 probed against a retired-but-bound rule version; a null key ACCEPTED and disclosed rather than refused; the two-trigger firing order asserted so that a correction to a published line is told the line is immutable rather than that its work type is unknown

statement: An erased Telegram identity is unrecoverable from any table or column the member plane can read: the subject's messages edit events member link and attachment filenames carry the surrogate or NULL and no table stores the original identifier or an unpeppered hash of it
enforcement: app.erase_telegram_identity rewrites under two transaction-local markers the message guard and the edit-event guard admit for that shape only; the registry stores an HMAC under the application pepper
